implementation: Upstream TrainDataset and VARTrainer.train_step, autocast FP16, original train-mode BatchNorm and DropPath, same four-image batch across four layer partitions

class_branches.0: aligned HR target, matching LR input subsequently bicubic-downsampled 4x and upsampled
class_branches.1: LR as target, the same LR image as input subsequently bicubic-downsampled 4x and upsampled

loss: upstream mean token CE + 0.2 RGB mean squared error + 0.8 upstream ThermalOrderConsistencyLoss(reduction=mean)
split_provenance: Proposed project-defined 1192/265 alternative to the unpublished author IDs. The proposal was withdrawn; no FLIR model update was performed.
